description: This file defines a class Pool used for managing concurrent HTTP requests using GuzzleHttp. It provides functionality to send multiple requests asynchronously with controlled concurrency, batch processing, and callback handling.

classes.name: Pool
classes.description: A class that manages concurrency for a set of HTTP requests, allowing them to be sent asynchronously with a pool size limit.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Pool with a client, a set of requests or functions, and configuration options such as concurrency and request options.

methods.name: promise
methods.description: Returns a promise that resolves when all requests in the pool have completed.

methods.name: batch
methods.description: Executes a batch of requests concurrently and returns an array of responses or exceptions in the order of the requests.
